events_detected.title: China $54bn state-bank recapitalization (biggest in two decades) met by falling bank shares + weaker CNY fixing
events_detected.description: Beijing to inject ~Y360bn (~$45-54bn per source) into eight state-owned banks and insurers, announced Sep 7 - largest recapitalization push in two decades (Semafor: 'biggest recapitalization push in decades'; moneycontrol: 'two decades'). Market verdict negative: state bank and insurer shares slid after the announcement; funding seen having 'limited short-term impact' on the economy amid weak credit demand (Nikkei); SCMP analysts: capital boost strengthens buffers but 'stronger fiscal support needed to reignite credit demand'. Separately, PBOC set a weaker USD/CNY fixing, signalling further renminbi depreciation risk. Read: Beijing moving from property-overhaul mode to DIRECT financial-system backstop = stress confirmation, not stimulus confidence. Escalates china_collapse 110 -> 120; feeds fin_stability.
